headline: Residential auction activity cools further into winter
caption: As we move deeper into the cooler months, fewer properties are coming to auction in the East Auckland market. While those listed are still selling at consistent rates, the slower supply gives both buyers and sellers important insights into seasonal trends. If you're thinking about your property move, understanding these patterns can help you time it right! 🏡
original_title: Residential auction activity cools off further in the back end of April
